name: WdFrameSizeRule
description: Specifies how Word interprets the rule used to determine the height or width of a frame.

constants.name: wdFrameAuto
constants.description: Sets the height or width according to the height or width of the item in the frame.

constants.name: wdFrameAtLeast
constants.description: Sets the height or width to a value equal to or greater than the value specified by the Height property or Width property.

constants.name: wdFrameExact
constants.description: Sets the height or width to an exact value specified by the Height property or Width property.
